code: enum Item { Pen, Pad, Ink } struct Record { item: Item, unit_price: Int, quantity: Int } fn cost(record: &Record) -> Int { record.unit_price * record.quantity } fn name(record: &Record) -> Str { match record.item { Item::Pen => "pen", Item::Pad => "pad", Item::Ink => "ink", } } fn main() { let pen = Record { item: Item::Pen, unit_price: 3, quantity: 4 }; let pad = Record { item: Item::Pad, unit_price: 9, quantity: 2 }; let ink = Record { item: Item::Ink, unit_price: 5, quantity: 3 }; let total_cost = cost(&pen) + cost(&pad) + cost(&ink); print(total_cost); let items = vec![&pen, &pad, &ink]; let most_expensive = items.iter().max_by_key(|r| cost(r)).unwrap(); print_str(name(most_expensive)); drop pen; drop pad; drop ink; }
